chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Baseer, who said:

It is inevitable that you should be saying regarding these stipulations, 'I hereby marry you with Mut'a, for such and such day, and with such and such Dirhams, a marriage without adultery, upon the Book of Allah Mighty and Majestic, and the Sunnah of His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and upon a stipulation that neither will you inherit me nor will I inherit you, and upon a stipulation that you will be observing a waiting period of forty five days'. And some of them (reporters) have said, 'One menstruation'.

key_terms.نِكَاحاً غَيْرَ سِفَاحٍ: Marriage without adultery (distinct from permanent marriage in some legal aspects)

ai.seo_question: What are the mandatory conditions for a valid Mut'a marriage according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the mandatory verbal stipulations for a valid Mut'a marriage, emphasizing the explicit declaration of duration and dowry to distinguish it from permanent marriage. It highlights the scholarly consensus on excluding inheritance rights and specifies the waiting period (iddah) as either forty-five days or one menstrual cycle, reflecting the practical legal safeguards unique to temporary unions in Shia jurisprudence. The requirement to cite the Quran and Sunnah grounds these stipulations in divine authority, ensuring the contract's validity is both legally sound and spiritually recognized.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at, from Abu Baseer,

‘Heasws said: ‘It is inevitable that you should be saying regarding these stipulations, ‘I hereby marry you with Mut’a, for such and such day, and with such and such Dirhams, a marriage without adultery, upon the Book of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, and a Sunnah of Hisazwj Prophetsaww, and upon a stipulation that neither will you inherit me nor will I inherit you, and upon a stipulation that you will be observing a waiting period of forty five days’. And some of them (reporters) have said, ‘One menstruation’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and a number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah from abu Basir who has said the following:

“He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is necessary that in marriage in the manner of al- Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) and its conditions one must say, “I form marriage with you in the manner of al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) for so and so many days with such and such amount of dirham as mahr (dower), a marriage free of indecency according to the book of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, and the Sunnah of Allah’s Holy prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, that you will not inherit me and I will not inherit you and that you must complete forty- five days of waiting period’” and certain ones have said that it is one cycle of Hayd (menses).”
